title: Signal restricts mobile screenshots as it confronts ‘existential threat’ of AI surveillance | TechCrunch
summary: Signal announced Friday that it’s limiting users’ ability to take screenshots within the secure messaging app — a response to what President Meredith Whittaker described as the “existential threat” of operating systems that integrate agentic AI.
